title: helm-private-values-v3-schema-upgrade-rollback: validate encryption/kms + init hook templating
author: Evan Brooks
description: Context: Private installer customers observed upgrade failures when migrating clusters with encrypted PVCs and when helm init jobs collide with node startup ordering. This PR ships a v3 values schema for the private Helm chart, adds validation for encryption/KMS-related fields, improves templating for the init-job hook to be idempotent across upgrades, and includes compatibility guards to make rollback safe for older values.yaml shapes. Changeset: 1) values.schema.json v3: tightened types for encryption.kmsKeyRef and storage classes, added deprecation mappings for legacy keys (private.storage.* -> storage.*) to allow smooth upgrades. 2) templates/init-job.yaml: make init hook conditional + idempotent, add exponential backoff on API retries, add nodeSelector/affinity fallbacks. 3) templates/hooks.yaml: annotate hooks with lifecycle notes and add pre-install/pre-upgrade/post-upgrade hooks to coordinate PV migrations. 4) Chart README and migration guide: document required linear tickets and sample rollback steps. 5) helm/unittest cases and CI e2e upgrade job: added a targeted upgrade/rollback scenario that mirrors customer repro. Motivation: reduce customer upgrade incidents and provide predictable behavior for encrypted volumes and KMS integration during chart upgrades. Checklist: - [x] values schema change and backward compatibility mappings - [x] idempotent init hooks with retries - [x] unit tests for helm chart linting and schema validation - [x] e2e upgrade/rollback CI job added (flaky guard added) - [x] docs/migration guide added Related: follows work in pr-51234-helm-private-values-init-hooks-schema-stabilize and pr-52389-helm-private-values-init-hooks-encryption-tolerations-upgrade-rollback. Deployment notes: merge to main triggers chart-release job; operators should read the migration guide before applying to clusters with encrypted PVCs.

release_notes:
- Upgrade chart values.schema.json to v3: validation for encryption.kmsKeyRef and deprecation mappings for legacy storage keys.
- Init hook templating: idempotent pre/post hooks with retry/backoff to avoid race conditions during node startup.
- Added migration guide detailing steps for clusters with encrypted PVCs and KMS integration.
- CI: new upgrade/rollback e2e job to catch regressions in chart lifecycle. Operators should read MIGRATION.md before upgrading clusters with encryption enabled.
